basic_info.description: San Francisco living in renowned Hayes Valley at this 800 sqft corner penthouse with 2 stories of windows, enclosed parking, and updated kitchen. Open living spaces greet you as you enter this 1BD/1.5BA condo, with views of the iconic City Hall dome. A foyer leads to the living room with updated fireplace and bay windows. Natural light floods in from the windows above that also are overlooked by the lofted bedroom. Entertaining is easy with a well sized kitchen with new stainless steel appliances, ample light from the skylight, and a pass-thru counter to the dining area. An updated half bath and front-load washer/dryer complete the first floor. Upstairs offers a large bedroom with space for an office nook, an updated en-suite full bathroom, and ample closet space. Ideally located to enjoy trendy Hayes Valley and SF dining, high-end boutiques, cultural, and arts favorites: performances at Symphony Hall, opera, ballet, or shows, renowned restaurants including Hayes St. Grill and Absinthe, cafes and multiple commute options (BART/Muni) are all right out your door. Parking is available in an easily accessed garage with assigned storage. Recent updates include new flooring, gas fireplace insert, bathroom tile, and paint. The building is complete with an elevator and private courtyard.
